review_notes: I read the whole file and compared its main declarations with the sibling definitions in Mathlib/Geometry (PresheafedSpace, SheafedSpace). The structure `LocallyRingedSpace` extends `SheafedSpace CommRingCat`, and `Hom` extends `PresheafedSpace.Hom`, so both reuse the existing structures. `toRingedSpace` is an abbreviation for `toSheafedSpace` and adds no competing concept. `toTopCat` and `𝒪` are small named accessors, and a PROJECT comment already discusses the `𝒪` pattern. `Γ` is built by composing `forgetToSheafedSpace.op` with `SheafedSpace.Γ`, and `forgetToTop` by composing with `SheafedSpace.forget`. `restrict`, `restrictStalkIso` and `ofRestrict` are thin lifts of the sheafed-space versions. `empty` and `emptyTo` are specific to locally ringed spaces, and I found no existing Mathlib version to replace them. The three overlapping `IsLocalHom` stalk-map instances are theorem-level redundancy, which the rubric excludes. I found no independent competing definition of an existing Mathlib concept. I did not search every use site beyond the Geometry directory.
